notes.title: NEW UPDATE!!! Version 1.09 - Beta Gym Release & MORE User Requests fulfilled
notes.content:
Earlier this week...




Have you ever lost a tough hand and wished you had a place to go and punch out all your frustration?  Well now you do!

We are excited to announce that Social Club VR : Casino nights has opened up… The Boxing Gym.  We know that many of our users have been dying for another space to explore. All you have to do is get in the elevator and go up to a whole new level of fun.  Now when you lose a tough hand you can head to the elevator and go punch out your frustration, and even gain Chips while you do it! 

[b]Features of this new Space:[/b]

[h1]Heavy Bags -[/h1] Work the Heavy Bag in a single or multi player competition designed to test your reflexes and skill.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32829996/dcd44b19db9954a813cac134b82ab074d12d098a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Speed Bags -[/h1] How fast can you move those hands?  And it’s not just purely about speed… with this challenge timing is everything.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32829996/e923c70627659b05457efb8762e7877d0538d7e4.jpg[/img]

[h1]Boxing Ring -[/h1] Grab a buddy and head to the ring for a 3, 5, or 7 round boxing extravaganza!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32829996/b27496fdbaae6408d0ed4b70f142497027ff1543.jpg[/img]

[h1]Weights –[/h1] Why not pick up some 45lb dumbbells and work out those biceps?
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32829996/dfdc8b9c63ea38a722a139ccf40dfc033f054ee4.jpg[/img]

Wonder what your friends are doing in the Casino while you are boxing? Turn on the Large Screen Display and get a birds eye view of everything happening in the Casino.

And while you’re in the gym, enjoy some sweet tunes while you work up a sweat! 


[h1]Version 1.09 Update also includes:[/h1]

- Texas Hold ’em: Club Chips are now more dynamic when you throw them in the pot before being cleaned up into nice stacks.
- Added "Game Results Voice Overs" (located in the Hand Menu’s “Gameplay/Graphics Settings” page). When set to OFF, the Win/Tied/Lost voice over sfx will not play at Casino games.
- Updated Gameplay Settings UI.
- Kicked players - if playing a game they will be kicked when they finish.
- Blackjack splitting a pair of aces bug fixed.
- Improved Stat/Achievement Tracking.

notes.title: FAQ
notes.content:
[h1]TUTORIALS[/h1]
[i]How can I watch a “basics” tutorial for Social Club VR : Casino Nights[/i]
Open the hand menu, select Settings, select Help, and then select Tutorial

[i]How can I watch tutorials to teach me how to play Poker, Blackjack and Roulette?[/i] 
Open the hand menu, select Settings, select Audio/Video, select the left button until it says “Video”, and select the middle “Cycle Source” button until it says “Default YouTube Videos”. 
[b]OR[/b]
Grab the Remote Control and hit the button in the upper left hand corner to cycle the source until it says “Video”, then select the top right hand button until is says, “Default YouTube Video”.

[h1]MEDIA[/h1]
[i]How do I get the picture I’ve taken in VR with the selfie stick?[/i]	
Go to your Hard Drive -> Users -> “UserName” -> Documents -> SocialClubVR -> UserPhotos.

[i]How do I add my own custom music?[/i] 
Go to your Hard Drive -> Users -> “UserName” -> Documents -> SocialClubVR -> UserMusic. Look for the “ReadmeHowToAudio.txt” file. Once you have followed the instructions provided in that file, launch the game.

[i]How do I listen to music I’ve added?[/i]
Open the hand menu, select Settings, select Audio/ Video, select Audio/ Video, select the left button until it says “Audio”, select the middle “Cycle Source” button until it says “User Music”
[b]OR[/b]
Grab the Remote Control and hit the button in the top left hand corner to cycle the source until it says “Audio”, then select the top right hand button until it says, “User Music”.

[i]How do I add my own custom videos?[/i]
Go to your Hard Drive -> Users -> “UserName” -> Documents -> SocialClubVR -> UserVideos. Look for the “ReadmeHowToVideo.txt” file. Once you have followed the instructions provided in that file, launch the game.

[i]How do I watch my custom videos?[/i] 
Open the hand menu, select Settings, select Audio/Video, select the left button until it says “Video”, and select the middle “Cycle Source” button until it says “User Videos”
[b]OR[/b]
Grab the Remote Control and hit the button in the upper left hand corner to cycle the source until it says “Video”, then select the top right hand button until it says, “User Videos”.

[i]How do I create my own custom YouTube playlists?[/i]
Go to your Hard Drive -> Users -> “UserName” -> Documents -> SocialClubVR -> UserVideos. Look for the “YouTubePlaylist.ini” file. Open it up in Notepad++ or any other text editing software. Once you have followed the instructions provided in that file, launch the game.

[i]How do I watch my YouTube playlists?[/i]
Open the hand menu, select Settings, select Audio/Video, select the left button until it says “Video”, and then select the middle “Cycle Source” button until it says “User YouTube Videos”.
[b]OR[/b]
Grab the Remote Control and hit the button in the upper left hand corner to cycle the source until it says “Video”, then select the top right hand button until is says, “User YouTube Videos”.
[b]**NOTE:[/b] Due to YouTube platform restrictions, not all videos are playable outside of the YouTube platform.

[i]How do I watch the host’s YouTube videos?[/i]
Open the hand menu, select Settings, select Audio/Video select left button until it says Video. Select cycle source until it says “Host User YouTube Videos”.
[b]OR[/b]
Grab the Remote Control and hit the button in the upper left hand corner to cycle the source until it says “Video”, then select the top right hand button until it says “Host User YouTube Videos”.

[i]What music file types are supported?[/i]
Mp3.

[i]What video file types are supported?[/i]
Mp4, avi, and wmv.

[h1]GAMEPLAY[/h1]
[i]How do I buy more chips?[/i]
Open the hand menu, select Store and select Club Chips.  Select the check mark, and then select the amount of chips you’d like to purchase.    

[i]How do I buy something for someone else?[/i]
Open the hand menu, select Store, select: Items, Toys, or Gear. On the far right is a Gifting page. Select the player you would like to buy the gift for, and then purchase the item. To switch back to purchasing items for yourself, select yourself in the Gifting page.

[i]How do I change my avatar’s color?[/i]
Open the hand menu, select Settings, select Preferred Color, and then select the color of your choice.

[i]How do I change my height?[/i]
Hold the grip button and the trigger buttons on both controllers. Then move your hands up or down to adjust your height

[i]How do I get the Chess pieces to appear?[/i]
Press the “Start Game” button at the end of the table that the chess board is placed on.

[i]How do I get the Backgammon game pieces to appear?[/i]
Press the “Start Game” button on either end of the table that the Backgammon board is placed on.

[h1]SETTINGS[/h1]
[i]How do I adjust the volume?[/i]
Open the hand menu, select Settings, select Audio/Video, and then use the trigger button to adjust the slider on any of the volume options. You can also pull the trigger on any of the mute icons to mute/unmute a volume option.

[i]How do I adjust the graphics?[/i]
Open the hand menu, select Settings, select Gameplay/Graphics, and then use the trigger button to adjust the sliders on any graphical option.

[i]What does the UI button do?[/i]
It allows you to add and subtract options while you are playing at a table. An example: The “Large Bets” and “Clean Table Buttons” can be put on your table or taken off your table with this button.
